description: Left the doors as they were and refused a third house.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Asked for a tall angry lady and agreed to stand where the plot put him.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Named tomorrow's Shrew and Thursday's ten shillings apiece.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked for a better door and did not get one.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused a new door and said he is off tomorrow's bill.
name: William Shakespeare
